copilot

```{r}
#install.packages("igraph")
#install.packages("ggraph")
#install.packages("tidyverse")

library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r }
# Define nodes (concepts)
nodes <- data.frame(
  id = c(
    "Clustering", "Concepts", "Cluster Tree", "Heatmap", "Faceting", 
    "Ordering", "Silhouette Statistics", "Algorithms", "K-Means", 
    "Hierarchical Clustering", "Cutting Tree", "Network Clustering Algorithm", 
    "Cluster Membership Using Color", "Centroids", "Applications", 
    "User Segmentation", "Gene Expression Profiling", "Users by Movie Ratings", 
    "Disease Transmission", "Contact Tracing"
  ),
  group = c(
    "Abstract", "Abstract", "Concept", "Concept", "Concept", "Concept",
    "Concept", "Abstract", "Algorithm", "Algorithm", "Algorithm", 
    "Algorithm", "Algorithm", "Algorithm", "Abstract", "Application", 
    "Application", "Application", "Application", "Application"
  )
)

# Define edges (connections between concepts)
edges <- data.frame(
  from = c(
    "Clustering", "Clustering", "Concepts", "Concepts", "Concepts", 
    "Concepts", "Concepts", "Clustering", "Algorithms", "Algorithms", 
    "Algorithms", "Algorithms", "Algorithms", "Clustering", "Applications", 
    "Applications", "Applications", "Applications", "Applications"
  ),
  to = c(
    "Concepts", "Algorithms", "Cluster Tree", "Heatmap", "Faceting", 
    "Ordering", "Silhouette Statistics", "Applications", "K-Means", 
    "Hierarchical Clustering", "Cutting Tree", "Network Clustering Algorithm", 
    "Centroids", "Applications", "User Segmentation", "Gene Expression Profiling", 
    "Users by Movie Ratings", "Disease Transmission", "Contact Tracing"
  )
)
```


create graph

```{r}
graph <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes, directed = TRUE)
print(nodes)
```

plot

```{r}
ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +  # Use Fruchterman-Reingold layout
  geom_edge_link(arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = group), size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = nodes$id), repel = TRUE, size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Concept Map: Clustering as a Tool for High-Level Structure",
    subtitle = "Abstract concepts, algorithms, and applications",
    color = "Category"
  )
```

visualize

```{r}
ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +  # Fruchterman-Reingold layout
  geom_edge_link(arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = group), size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = nodes$id), repel = TRUE, size = 4) +  # Use node labels as text
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Concept Map: Clustering as a Tool for High-Level Structure",
    subtitle = "Abstract concepts, algorithms, and applications",
    color = "Category"
  )

```
